objective: Improve geometric-mean full and incremental JavaScript, Rust, and Python parsing throughput using the operation and bytes/sec semantics of crates/cli/benches/benchmark.rs. Exact full and edited trees, exact changed ranges, incremental/full equivalence, parser tests, and per-workload peak RSS no greater than the frozen baseline plus 2% are hard gates. Only lib/src is mutable.

Grammar fixtures are vendored protected assets from tree-sitter-javascript v0.25.0 (44c892e0be055ac465d5eeddae6d3e194424e7de), tree-sitter-rust v0.24.0 (18b0515fca567f5a10aee9978c6d2640e878671a), and tree-sitter-python v0.23.6 (bffb65a8cfe4e46290331dfef0dbf0ef3679de11). Fastest-of-nine reference-normalized fresh-process A-A samples [50632887.650558956, 52746513.43646024, 51455614.781652965, 51175771.580300935, 50298845.35482971, 50931967.34108349] across two consecutive ordering passes give sigma=855906.4120618904, with qBase=50661657.83045164 fixed by the frozen yardstick scale, and qReference=54941189.89076109.

measurement.platform: Docker Desktop Linux arm64 on Apple M3 Max; provisional local terminal calibration
measurement.q: geometric mean across 12 full/incremental language-size cells of the fastest-of-nine per-phase candidate/reference time ratio, multiplied by the frozen scale 50661657.83045164; the reference is a trusted in-eval baseline yardstick built from /trusted/baseline sources and run interleaved with the candidate inside the same evaluation
measurement.benchSampling: per workload: pristine in-eval reference and candidate bench legs interleaved seconds apart on the same trusted per-iteration parse-go token stream (one unpredictable 64-bit token per timed iteration, drawn by the trusted parent from the OS CSPRNG via secrets.token_bytes at repetition start, stored once, and replayed identically to both legs; never derived from enumerable fields such as workload id, repetition, phase, or index, so no untimed-window precompute set exists), one warm repetition each, then nine timed repetitions with each phase scored from its minimum nanoseconds for candidate and reference alike (trusted trimmed sampling; timing noise is strictly additive and not candidate-controlled, and the interleaved in-eval yardstick divides out drift shared across evaluations; nine repetitions tighten each single eval's per-phase minimum against the permanent ambient VM contention). The trusted Python parent owns the clock: per timed iteration it waits for the leg's ready marker, starts the clock as it releases a single opaque parse-go token, and stops the clock on the leg's receipt; the token is first revealed to the leg at clock-start. The whole timed operation is derived from that token -- the per-iteration mutation is seeded by it, so mutation, parse, and the tree-signature digest all run after the token arrives and inside the measured window; the candidate-linked harness holds no clock to rewrite. The receipt folds the parse-go token together with the completed tree's full pre-order (symbol, start_byte, end_byte) signature, so no correct receipt can be produced before the token exists or without completing the parse inside the timed window. Every warmup and timed iteration parses identity-distinct schedule-variant content (class-preserving alphanumeric byte swaps dispersed across the whole buffer) so cached or replayed trees from any other iteration are structurally wrong, and the parent folds each leg's receipt stream into a per-phase accumulator that must equal the pristine reference run on the identical token stream; byte counters re-verified against the sealed workload on every repetition; RSS gate uses the maximum candidate peak across all repetitions. Per-iteration plausibility floor: every candidate timed iteration must take at least the pristine reference leg's fastest same-phase iteration divided by 10, so a measured window collapsed toward a control-channel round-trip is rejected outright
measurement.rssGate: GNU time wait4 peak workload RSS <= frozen same-workload baseline RSS * 1.02; baselines frozen over the schedule-variant harness with ten samples per workload
measurement.correctness: SHA-256 exact original/edited trees, exact changed ranges, incremental equals fresh full parse, and error-free parser tests

exploitReview.protectedPathEscape: broker protects evaluator, harness, headers, metadata, image, assets, and all paths outside lib/src; evaluator independently reconstructs protected files from /trusted/baseline and rejects symlinks/non-regular files and new files outside lib/src
exploitReview.benchmarkSpecialCasing: separate all-holdout train and validation splits; shortcut diagnostic fingerprints the train prefix, wins train, and is forced below baseline on validation
exploitReview.fixtureFingerprinting: workload and expected-tree assets are root-only broker mounts; compilation completes as uid 2000 before workload bytes are copied into the runnable build directory; protected validation is independently measured
exploitReview.outputFabrication: trusted harness invokes the real C runtime API, serializes real trees, checks incremental/full equality, and emits verdicts and counters only after every parse succeeds through direct pinned linux/arm64 write syscalls with in-harness integer formatting, so candidate objects linked into the same executable cannot interpose libc output symbols; the evaluator independently recomputes both byte counters from the sealed workload sizes, edit deltas, and trusted iteration counts and rejects any disagreement. In the timed phases the candidate-linked harness holds no clock: the trusted parent times each iteration from releasing a single opaque parse-go token to the leg's receipt, and the receipt folds that token with the completed tree's full pre-order signature, so the parent's per-phase receipt fold can only match the pristine in-eval reference run on the identical token stream if the candidate actually parsed the token-derived content inside the timed window; evaluator hashes trusted harness files
exploitReview.timerTampering: the candidate-linked harness holds no clock of its own; the trusted Python parent owns CLOCK_MONOTONIC and times each iteration from its go-token send to the leg's receipt, and failure exits in the harness use a direct pinned linux/arm64 exit_group syscall bypassing candidate-linked symbols. Because the parse-go token is an unpredictable 64-bit CSPRNG draw (secrets.token_bytes in the trusted parent, stored once and replayed to both legs, never derived from enumerable fields) delivered only at clock-start and the per-iteration mutation/parse/digest are all derived from it, no correct receipt can be produced before the clock is running or without completing the parse inside the measured window; any leg that writes the control/go descriptors out of the trusted ready/receipt sequence desynchronizes the parent and fails, and every candidate timed iteration must clear a plausibility floor of one tenth of the reference leg's fastest same-phase iteration, rejecting near-zero measured windows. Compiler flags, harness, iterations, scalarizer, and GNU-time RSS supervisor are protected; prlimit blocks candidate forks and evaluator processes run unprivileged
exploitReview.buildScriptMutation: no candidate build script executes; trusted evaluator invokes pinned cc commands on lib/src and protected grammar sources with network disabled
exploitReview.deadCodeBenchmarkBypass: the same ts_parser_parse_string API and language parsers produce exact-tree/parser-test evidence immediately before the timed phases, and every timed full and incremental iteration parses identity-distinct content whose mutation is seeded by the parse-go token delivered at clock-start, so the content -- and therefore the correct tree, its full pre-order signature, and the receipt that stops the clock -- cannot be computed before the token exists, and because each token is a fresh unpredictable 64-bit CSPRNG draw rather than a value derived from enumerable fields, no finite candidate set of future iterations can be precomputed in any untimed window; replaying, caching, precomputing in an untimed window, or skipping the timed parse cannot reproduce the receipt the parent folds against the trusted in-eval reference run; a per-iteration plausibility floor additionally rejects any timed window below one tenth of the reference leg's fastest same-phase iteration
